# MagicSync

MagicSync is an all-in-one social media management platform for small businesses.
Schedule posts, engage customers and track results across Facebook, Instagram,
X/Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google Business Profile, Pinterest and more.
Available as a free self-hosted version or Pro cloud plan ($29/month).

## Key pages

- Homepage: https://magicsync.dev/
- Free tools: https://magicsync.dev/tools
- Blog: https://magicsync.dev/blog
- Platform integrations: https://magicsync.dev/platform
- About: https://magicsync.dev/about-us
